after.description: Answers whether the selected Run ID can be exact-replayed from saved evidence. The first screen shows exact replay readiness, the saved Trust verdict, and retention. Collapsed rows hold checkpoint validation, manifest validation, identity, run details, discovery, and saved domain reasons.

panels.description: Sanitizer-compatible navigation bus with native keyboard focus. Shared link-only bus 0–6: Run Explorer / Trust / Overview / Run Overview / Provider Health / Data Quality / Incident Workspace. Current workspace is a non-interactive chip (aria-disabled + data-current=page, underlined) so active state is not color-only. Handoffs open same-tab, preserve current time range, and document scope reset or context mapping on cross-scope transitions. Chip colors are theme-safe for dark and light.

panels.description: SELECTED RUN · Read exact replay readiness first, then the saved Trust verdict, then retention. Blockers for that readiness are in Review Exact Replay Checks. Those three answers use the selected Run ID. They do not use current Prometheus telemetry.

options.content:
${pipeline:text} | ${run_id}
Blockers: Review Exact Replay Checks.

panels.description: SELECTED RUN · Saved exact-replay assessment, not CURRENT health. OK/WARN/CRIT palette: READY=OK, INSUFFICIENT=WARN, BLOCKED=CRIT. UNSUPPORTED/UNKNOWN/INCOMPLETE are gray. SELECT RUN means no Run ID is selected; QUERY ERROR means backend unavailable or request failure. UNKNOWN means no assessed value, never READY. Open replay checks for basis. Occurrence-only versus semantic drift still requires exact-run evidence; current write-risk telemetry is not proof for this run. VALID EMPTY means an empty successful response; it does not replace UNKNOWN for missing required evidence. Backend failure renders as QUERY ERROR and must not be interpreted as an empty successful response. Empty is a coverage gap: required saved evidence is missing, not a pass. Request failure is QUERY ERROR.
panels.title: Review Exact Replay Readiness

panels.description: SELECTED RUN · One row per readiness check for this Run ID. Fail blocks replay. Unknown is not a pass. Valid-empty check output stays VALID EMPTY. Request failure is QUERY ERROR. VALID EMPTY means an empty successful response; it does not replace UNKNOWN for missing required evidence. Backend failure renders as QUERY ERROR and must not be interpreted as an empty successful response.

manifest_not_recorded.text: manifest for this run was not recorded

targets.uql: parse-json | jsonata "replay_checks^(result='fail' ? 0 : result='unknown' ? 1 : result='pass' ? 2 : 3)"

panels.title: Review Exact Replay Checks

panels.description: SELECTED RUN · All identity anchors, missing first. Presence is not verification. VALID EMPTY means the successful response contains no anchors. Exact Replay Checks determines readiness. Inspect a value to copy it in full. No rows is not a pass; missing evidence is UNKNOWN and failed requests are QUERY ERROR. VALID EMPTY means an empty successful response; it does not replace UNKNOWN for missing required evidence. Backend failure renders as QUERY ERROR and must not be interpreted as an empty successful response. Empty is a coverage gap: required saved evidence is missing, not a pass. Request failure is QUERY ERROR.

targets.uql: parse-json | jsonata "rows^(present ? 1 : 0, priority, name)"

panels.title: Review Replay Evidence

panels.description: SELECTED RUN · processing_status is the saved ETL outcome. trust_status is the historical Trust assessment and does not authorize replay. Reason count is the number of saved remarks. Assessed at is when that assessment was recorded. VALID EMPTY means an empty successful response; it does not replace UNKNOWN for missing required evidence. Backend failure renders as QUERY ERROR and must not be interpreted as an empty successful response. Empty is a coverage gap: required saved evidence is missing, not a pass. Request failure is QUERY ERROR.

defaults.noValue: SELECT RUN if no Run ID is selected. QUERY ERROR if the request failed.

VALID EMPTY means an empty successful response; it does not replace UNKNOWN for missing required evidence. Backend failure renders as QUERY ERROR and must not be interpreted as an empty successful response. Empty is a coverage gap: required saved evidence is missing, not a pass. Request failure is QUERY ERROR.

defaults.noValue: SELECT RUN if no Run ID is selected. QUERY ERROR if the request failed.

panels.title: Review Manifest Validation

panels.description: SELECTED RUN · Lineage closure, identity consistency, cycle freedom, and persistence profile for this Run ID. UNKNOWN is not a healthy zero. No rows can be a valid empty result. A failed request is not OK. VALID EMPTY means an empty successful response; it does not replace UNKNOWN for missing required evidence. Backend failure renders as QUERY ERROR and must not be interpreted as an empty successful response.

defaults.noValue: SELECT RUN if no Run ID is selected. QUERY ERROR if the request failed.

panels.title: Review Lineage Validation

panels.description: SELECTED RUN · Five retention rows for this Run ID: policy, evidence floor, required evidence, snapshot evidence, and archive. UNKNOWN is not a healthy zero. No rows can be a valid empty result. A failed request is not OK. Archive N/A means a referenced policy does not require archiving; it is not proof of an archive. Archive verified means local copies and restore evidence passed current hash and identity checks. VALID EMPTY means an empty successful response; it does not replace UNKNOWN for missing required evidence. Backend failure renders as QUERY ERROR and must not be interpreted as an empty successful response.

defaults.noValue: SELECT RUN if no Run ID is selected. QUERY ERROR if the request failed. HTTP 504 is a query error, not an empty result.

Request failure is QUERY ERROR.

list.description: Shared operator context: workflow evidence selector. This selector does not imply exact current-status intersection unless the dashboard explicitly documents that semantics.
list.label: Workflow
list.name: workflow

list.description: Core scope: pipeline option list from the local control-plane catalog (/ops/control-plane/filter-options?dimension=pipeline), not the Prometheus universe. PromQL current-state panels still match $pipeline against the shared universe metrics. Single-select unless this board documents All. Default selection is All pipelines until the operator narrows to a concrete pipeline. A pasted var-pipeline value that exists in the catalog remains selectable even when Prometheus has no series.
list.label: Pipeline
list.name: pipeline

list.description: Core scope: run_type selector bounded by the active control-plane pipeline universe. Default All is intentional; missing run-type context must be represented as All, not unknown. Default run_type is backfill (SEL-P0 fallback); Include All remains available for aggregate diagnostics.
list.label: Run Type
list.name: run_type

list.description: Shared operator identity context sourced from the local control-plane run-manifest catalog. The selector defaults to - and affects only local HTTP identity panels; it MUST NOT be used in Prometheus labels or cross-dashboard handoffs. Run ID options are ordered by start time descending from the control-plane catalog; Grafana sort is disabled so backend order is preserved.
list.label: Run ID
list.name: run_id

list.description: Select one control-plane global read-latency quantile. Default p95 keeps a single series per store/operation instead of overlaying p50/p95/p99. Track Global Read Latency shows last and max for the selected quantile.
list.label: Read latency
list.name: read_latency_quantile

list.description: Hidden selector: resolves the provider owning the selected pipeline so cross-dashboard handoffs can prefill $provider without operator input.
list.label: Provider for pipeline

panels.description: SELECTED RUN · Overall verdict is the data quality assessment of this Run ID. Processing is the ETL outcome. Trust is the saved Trust verdict and does not authorize replay. Saved evidence for this Run ID. Missing checks are INCOMPLETE; missing selection is SELECT RUN; request failure is QUERY ERROR. N/A means explicitly inapplicable. VALID EMPTY is an empty successful query. This saved verdict does not authorize replay. Reason explains the saved assessment; missing archive evidence remains INCOMPLETE. Evidence completeness remains available in the saved report. VALID EMPTY means an empty successful response; it does not replace UNKNOWN for missing required evidence. Backend failure renders as QUERY ERROR and must not be interpreted as an empty successful response.

'Result not recorded' : $d.reason_display) }), '; ') : presentation_summary[0].reason)}])]

'Result not recorded' : $d.reason_display) }), '; ') : presentation_summary[0].reason)}])]"

panels.description: SELECTED RUN · Selected run: Compact identity table showing Run ID, Manifest ID, Provider.Entity [Version], Contract [Schema], Execution, Replay [Capability.Mode], Checkpoint [Anchors], and Identity Health. Exact selected run_id wins; aggregate pipeline scope without exact run_id must not guess one manifest identity. No data/datasource errors mean the BioETL Ops HTTP backend may be unavailable; verify /health/live before interpreting as expected empty. Fail-closed: timeout, empty, or unresolved identity must render UNKNOWN/INCOMPLETE/NO DATA — never a synthetic healthy zero. Inspect value opens full identifiers as selectable plain text. VALID EMPTY means an empty successful response; it does not replace UNKNOWN for missing required evidence. Backend failure renders as QUERY ERROR and must not be interpreted as an empty successful response.

panels.description: SELECTED RUN · Saved accounting: count in is the input of each stage, repeated across its outcome rows. count out is the outcome count. Percentages retain their original denominator and display one decimal place. Gold/Silver % are of Bronze count; missing denominator stays N/A. N/A means the value was not recorded. Skipped outcomes are hidden. Empty is a coverage gap: required saved evidence is missing, not a pass. Request failure is QUERY ERROR. VALID EMPTY means an empty successful response; it does not replace UNKNOWN for missing required evidence. Backend failure renders as QUERY ERROR and must not be interpreted as an empty successful response.

'bronze' : ($contains($p, 'silver') ? 'silver' : 'gold'); {'parameter': $p, 'count in': $f[stage_id = $layerName].records_in}) }))"

panels.description: Expand for saved stage rows (Inspect Selected Run Stages), domain verdicts (Inspect Selected Run Domains), and full identity (Inspect Selected Run Identity) of the selected Run ID.

SELECTED RUN · Saved stage rows for the exact Run ID; the table shows at most 12 stages. SUCCESS with missing stage evidence stays INCOMPLETE. A recorded zero stays 0. An unknown count is empty, not 0. UNFINISHED means no terminal event. Prometheus does not change this table. Request failure is QUERY ERROR. Removal counters are per-stage saved funnel removals; untracked stages stay UNKNOWN. VALID EMPTY means an empty successful response; it does not replace UNKNOWN for missing required evidence. Backend failure renders as QUERY ERROR and must not be interpreted as an empty successful response. Empty is a coverage gap: required saved evidence is missing, not a pass. Request failure is QUERY ERROR.

targets.uql: parse-json | jsonata "($r := function($s,$o){$exists($s.removals[outcome=$o]) ? $sum($s.removals[outcome=$o].count) : ($s.tracking = 'full' ? 0 : null)}; $map(funnel, function($s){ {'stage_id':$s.stage_id, 'quarantined':$r($s,'quarantined'), 'excluded':$r($s,'excluded_by_contract'), 'deduplicated':$r($s,'deduplicated'), 'filtered_out':$r($s,'filtered_out')} }))"

panels.description: Explains the incident-triage question and the evidence scopes used on this read-only dashboard. CURRENT ranks suspects from current fleet telemetry in GLOBAL scope; Pipeline and Run ID do not filter suspects. SELECTED RUN uses HTTP-backed evidence for one exact run; run_id never filters Prometheus. No suspects means none were found in the current scope and does not prove the fleet is healthy Run coverage: IN RANGE / OUT OF RANGE / UNKNOWN. Set range to run when OUT OF RANGE. Effective refresh: 60s · timezone: browser. Effective filters: provider=${provider}. VALID EMPTY is an empty suspect list, not a healthy fleet.

panels.description: CURRENT · Endpoint is scrape availability; expected stage signals measure presence, not freshness. Rule age is evaluation age, not event freshness. Monitoring quality (10m) reports missing telemetry, rule failures or missed evaluations in the last 10 minutes, including recovered events. DEGRADED is a monitoring warning, not proof that the selected pipeline has incomplete stage evidence. Evidence confidence is monitoring quality, not the selected Run ID verdict.

panels.description: SELECTED RUN · Completed at minus started at, as in Run Explorer. This is the entire run, not individual stage timing. No selection stays SELECT RUN; missing timestamps stay UNKNOWN. VALID EMPTY means an empty successful response; it does not replace UNKNOWN for missing required evidence. Backend failure renders as QUERY ERROR and must not be interpreted as an empty successful response. Empty is a coverage gap: required saved evidence is missing, not a pass. Request failure is QUERY ERROR.

panels.description: TIME RANGE · Duration quantiles require observed histogram increments within the rate interval. An empty chart is UNKNOWN, not zero duration or a failed run. NaN quantiles are omitted; isolated valid observations are shown as points. Histogram generation guard: windows with a changed producer creation timestamp are omitted for the whole aggregate. A repeated batch snapshot is not a continuous counter; narrow the window to one stable generation. Omitted values do not mean zero latency.

(histogram_quantile(0.95, (sum by (le, phase, status) (rate(bioetl_phase_duration_seconds_bucket{pipeline=~"$pipeline"}[$__rate_interval])) unless on (phase, status) (sum by (phase, status) (changes(bioetl_phase_duration_seconds_created{pipeline=~"$pipeline"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0))))) >= 0

(histogram_quantile(0.99, (sum by (le, phase, status) (rate(bioetl_phase_duration_seconds_bucket{pipeline=~"$pipeline"}[$__rate_interval])) unless on (phase, status) (sum by (phase, status) (changes(bioetl_phase_duration_seconds_created{pipeline=~"$pipeline"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0))))) >= 0

Coverage contract

SELECTED RUN · Saved stage rows for the exact Run ID; the table shows at most 12 stages. SUCCESS with missing stage evidence stays INCOMPLETE. A recorded zero stays 0. An unknown count is empty, not 0. UNFINISHED means no terminal event. Prometheus does not change this table. Request failure is QUERY ERROR. Removal counters are per-stage saved funnel removals; untracked stages stay UNKNOWN. VALID EMPTY means an empty successful response; it does not replace UNKNOWN for missing required evidence. Backend failure renders as QUERY ERROR and must not be interpreted as an empty successful response. Empty is a coverage gap: required saved evidence is missing, not a pass. Request failure is QUERY ERROR.

targets.uql: parse-json | jsonata "($r := function($s,$o){$exists($s.removals[outcome=$o]) ? $sum($s.removals[outcome=$o].count) : ($s.tracking = 'full' ? 0 : null)}; $map(funnel, function($s){ {'stage_id':$s.stage_id, 'quarantined':$r($s,'quarantined'), 'excluded':$r($s,'excluded_by_contract'), 'deduplicated':$r($s,'deduplicated'), 'filtered_out':$r($s,'filtered_out')} }))"

list.description: Core scope: pipeline option list from the local control-plane catalog (/ops/control-plane/filter-options?dimension=pipeline), not the Prometheus universe. list.description: Shared operator identity context sourced from the local control-plane run-manifest catalog. The selector defaults to - and affects only local HTTP identity panels; it MUST NOT be used in Prometheus labels or cross-dashboard handoffs. list.description: Provider scope: derived from Pipeline when set (first name segment, same heuristic as runtime $provider_hint), else from Workflow when set; fail-closed default is unknown when neither Pipeline nor Workflow is set. panels.description: Sanitizer-compatible navigation bus with native keyboard focus. Shared link-only bus: Run Explorer / Replay Readiness / Run Overview / Incident Workspace. Data Quality is a contextual detail destination. Current workspace is a non-interactive chip (aria-disabled + data-current=page, underlined) so active state is not color-only. panels.description: SELECTED RUN · Saved provider check result. Missing evidence stays UNKNOWN. OK/WARN/CRIT color the saved check verdict, not live fleet health. SELECT RUN means no Run ID is selected. VALID EMPTY means no saved provider check. QUERY ERROR means backend unavailable or request failure. VALID EMPTY means an empty successful response; it does not replace UNKNOWN for missing required evidence. Backend failure renders as QUERY ERROR and must not be interpreted as an empty successful response.
panels.title: Review Provider Check

panels.description: SELECTED RUN · Saved stage rows for the exact Run ID; the table shows at most 12 stages. SUCCESS with missing stage evidence stays INCOMPLETE. A recorded zero stays 0. An unknown count is empty, not 0. UNFINISHED means no terminal event. Prometheus does not change this table. Request failure is QUERY ERROR. Removal counters are per-stage saved funnel removals; untracked stages stay UNKNOWN. Excluded % is excluded_by_contract / stage records in; Saved % is records out / stage records in. Empty or incomplete inputs are UNKNOWN. VALID EMPTY means an empty successful response; it does not replace UNKNOWN for missing required evidence. Backend failure renders as QUERY ERROR and must not be interpreted as an empty successful response. Empty is a coverage gap: required saved evidence is missing, not a pass. Request failure is QUERY ERROR.

after.description: Run Explorer: latest 10 launches across all pipelines by start time, from reports and the control-plane catalog. Defaults Workflow/Pipeline/Run Type=All, Run ID=-. Details use exact Ops HTTP evidence; run_id never a Prometheus label.

panels.description: Browse the latest 10 launches across All pipelines by start time. Workflow and Run Type filter the list. The dashboard time picker does not filter this table. Running means a recorded start without a terminal event, not a live health probe. REPORT MISSING means no final report is available. Defaults All / All / All and run_id=- select no exact run. Effective refresh: 60s; timezone: browser.

options.content:
Last 10 launches · newest first · independent of the time range
Select a status to view details. Reset filters

panels.description: GLOBAL · BROWSE the launch catalog filtered by Workflow/Pipeline/Run Type. Last 10 launches, newest Started first, independent of the time range. Workflow and Pipeline open passports. Run ID opens the persisted Report; inspect its full UUID in the cell. Overview is processing status, not replay readiness. Saved Evidence, Data Quality and Replay Readiness use exact-run verified evidence. N/A means unsupported/legacy assessment. INCOMPLETE means missing required evidence. IN PROGRESS requires an explicit assessment queue/running signal and is never inferred. QUERY ERROR is a source failure; VALID EMPTY means no matching launches. Rows are artifact-backed: a tree_missing index means saved run artifacts are absent; verify backing with verify_report_bind.py. Running is a recorded state, not proof of current liveness. Missing reports have no link. VALID EMPTY means an empty successful response; it does not replace UNKNOWN for missing required evidence. Backend failure renders as QUERY ERROR and must not be interpreted as an empty successful response.

defaults.noValue: UNKNOWN — the launches table returned no rows for these filters. QUERY ERROR means the backend request failed, not an empty fleet.

value.tooltip: Saved Provider Evidence for the selected Run ID. CURRENT provider alert conditions remain in Incident Workspace and do not prove this saved verdict.
